summary: Frontend E2E test of iter293 Multi-Lot Vehicle Auction + UpcomingCountdownBadge + Notify-Me + Dealer Drafts Dashboard + Admin Panel audit. Logged in successfully as charbel911@gmail.com via /auth (note: /login redirects to 404, /auth is the actual route). Multi-Lot create page, draft submission, detail page rendering, and admin sub-panels all PASS. Tab routing and one path discrepancy noted.

ui_bugs.issue: /login URL renders 404 'Page not found' overlay. The login page actually lives at /auth. Either alias /login -> /auth or update all links that point to /login.

Route is /vehicle-auctions/my-listings. The review request listed /vehicles/my-listings and /my-vehicle-listings (both return 404 / nav unchanged). Confirm the intended user-facing URL and add the missing alias if needed.
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' (8+ occurrences) — missing key= in map() loop.

After creating a multi-lot DRAFT, Drafts tab still shows count (0). Drafts tab only counts single-vehicle drafts; multi-lot drafts have no entry point on this page. Confirm with PM whether multi-lot drafts should also be surfaced here, or add a separate 'Multi-Lot Drafts' tab.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking Admin Logs sub-tab, table renders 0 rows; UI shows a loading spinner that never resolves in the 3.5s wait window. May simply need more time but worth verifying the /api/admin/logs endpoint returns data.

test_results.submit_multi_lot_schedule_btn: NOT TESTED separately — schedule path equivalent confirmed via the draft case (start_time +1h yielded UPCOMING lot rows).

test_results.admin_manage_all_auctions: PASS — Total Auctions=6, [data-testid=view-btn-*] count=25, section badges include '🛒 Marketplace' and '🚚 Multi-Lot Vehicle' (2 distinct collections confirmed). Search input present.
test_results.admin_user_management: PASS — User Management tab renders with stats (10 total users / 2 individual), 'Create New User' button visible. Verify-button click NOT executed (test data dependent).
test_results.admin_listings_moderation: PASS — tab renders; ?tab=lots also routes to the same admin dashboard (consolidated).
test_results.admin_flagged_listings: PASS — tab clicked without JS exception (only pre-existing React 'key' warnings).
test_results.admin_disputed_settlements: PASS — sub-tab present with [data-testid=admin-tab-disputed-settlements], navigation works.
test_results.admin_vehicles: PASS — [data-testid=admin-primary-tab-vehicles] present in primary tab list.
test_results.admin_analytics: PASS — [data-testid=admin-primary-tab-analytics] click rendered 44 canvas/svg chart nodes; no JS errors.

action_items: Decide intent of /vehicles/my-listings vs /vehicle-auctions/my-listings — review request used the former, app exposes only the latter. Add alias if /vehicles/my-listings should also resolve.
Fix /login route 404 — alias /login to /auth (multiple references in test brief and likely external links assume /login).
Confirm whether multi-lot drafts should appear in the Drafts tab on /vehicle-auctions/my-listings (currently only single-vehicle drafts counted; new multi-lot draft I created showed count 0).
Fix EnhancedUserManager 'unique key prop' React warning (8 instances).
Verify Admin Logs panel actually fetches /api/admin/logs (currently spinner did not resolve in 3.5s window — could be slow or broken).
critical_code_review_comments: Login page lives at /auth but app/test conventions refer to /login. Inconsistent — should be aliased.
Drafts dashboard scope ambiguity: multi-lot drafts are first-class objects but invisible to dealers on the main 'My Listings' page.
EnhancedUserManager missing list keys — perf + correctness risk under re-renders.
